sections.heading: 1. Operator
sections.body: The site and services are provided by Live Well S.R.L., trading as ALIVE Bistro, with its registered office at Str. Mureș nr. 115A, corp D, Timișoara, Romania. Contact details are on the Contact page.

sections.heading: 2. Orders and prices
sections.body: Prices are in Romanian lei (RON) and include VAT. An order is registered once the restaurant confirms it. Items are prepared to order, subject to availability.

sections.heading: 3. Pickup and delivery
sections.body: Orders are collected at the restaurant at the time given at confirmation. Home delivery, when available, is provided through partner platforms (Glovo, Wolt, Bolt Food) under their terms.

sections.heading: 4. Online payment
sections.body: Card payments are processed securely through BT iPay, a Banca Transilvania service. ALIVE Bistro does not see or store your card data.

sections.heading: 5. Cancellation, returns and complaints
sections.body: Cancellation and return conditions are set out in the Cancellation policy and Return policy, which you accept when placing an order.

sections.heading: 6. Dispute resolution
sections.body: You can contact us at any time with complaints. For alternative dispute resolution you can use ANPC: https://anpc.ro/ce-este-sal/ , and for the EU ODR platform: https://ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr

sections.heading: 7. Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by Romanian law. We may amend them; the version published on the site applies.

sections.heading: Cancellation by the customer
sections.body: You can cancel for free until the restaurant confirms the order or starts preparing it, within 5 minutes of placing it. Cancel by phone at 0737 263 469. Once preparation starts the order cannot be cancelled, because food is made to order.

sections.heading: Cancellation by the restaurant
sections.body: We may cancel an order if an item is unavailable, a displayed price was wrong, or we cannot fulfil it. We will notify you immediately.

sections.heading: Refunds
sections.body: If you paid online and the order is cancelled under this policy, the amount is refunded to the card used, within 5 working days of cancellation. The time it appears depends on your issuing bank.

sections.heading: Right of withdrawal
sections.body: Our products are freshly prepared food made to order that can spoil quickly. Under art. 16 of Romanian Government Emergency Ordinance 34/2014, the 14-day right of withdrawal does not apply to such products and prepared food cannot be returned. We inform you of this before you place an order.

sections.heading: Wrong, incomplete or defective order
sections.body: If you receive different items than ordered, missing items or items of unsatisfactory quality, tell us right away at pickup or the same day at 0737 263 469, with a photo of the item. Depending on the case we will replace the item, issue a voucher or refund the affected item.

sections.heading: Refunds
sections.body: Refunds for online payments are made to the card used for the order, within 5 working days of the complaint being approved.

sections.heading: Allergens
sections.body: Allergen information is shown in the menu. If you have allergies, tell us before ordering.

privacy.title: Privacy notice for accounts and push notifications

sections.heading: Scope
sections.body: This notice describes the technical data processing required for marketing push notifications. Other website features may involve additional processing that must be described separately.

sections.heading: Controller and contact
sections.body: The controller is Live Well S.R.L. (ALIVE Bistro), Romanian tax ID RO53384964, contact address: Str. Mureș nr. 115A, corp D, Timișoara, Romania. For questions or requests about personal data, email adela.asanache@gmail.com or call 0737 263 469.

sections.heading: Purposes and legal bases
sections.body: We use account data to authenticate you and provide account services you request. We use your consent (GDPR Article 6(1)(a)) to send ALIVE news and promotional offers by push notification. This consent is separate and voluntary. Installing the app, creating an account, or granting browser permission alone does not constitute marketing consent. Refusal does not affect your account, points, or voucher.

sections.heading: Push data
sections.body: When you enable push, we store the account identifier, the technical delivery address (endpoint), subscription cryptographic keys, registration time, and a record of consent or withdrawal with the notice version. We also retain technical campaign and delivery-status records. Do not include sensitive or personal details in promotional notifications; they may appear on your lock screen and after you sign out.

sections.heading: Recipients and transfers
sections.body: We use Cloudflare services for hosting and database storage. Web Push delivery is handled by the device/browser platform's push service, which may be Google/Firebase, Apple, Mozilla, or Microsoft. Providers process technical data needed for delivery under their own terms. Depending on the provider and configuration, data may be processed outside the European Economic Area. Contact the controller for details of safeguards applicable to the configuration in use; these must be confirmed before campaigns.

sections.heading: Retention
sections.body: The technical subscription is retained while consent is active and is deleted from our server when you withdraw consent or the push provider reports it as expired. Consent and withdrawal records are deleted during the first daily cleanup after the 12-month period from withdrawal. Delivery and campaign records are deleted during the first daily cleanup after 12 months from campaign creation; a delivery actively being processed at that time is allowed to finish. Active consent records remain until withdrawal.

sections.heading: Choice and withdrawal
sections.body: Push consent is optional and separate from email marketing. You can withdraw it at any time in your account's push preferences; withdrawal stops future sends to all devices associated with your account and deletes subscriptions from our server. Messages already accepted by a push service may still arrive. Blocking notifications in device settings stops display, but to withdraw consent in our records, also use the account setting.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: Subject to GDPR conditions and limits, you may request access, rectification, erasure or restriction of processing, data portability, and object where applicable. You may withdraw consent at any time; this does not affect the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal. To exercise your rights, contact us at the email above. You may also lodge a complaint with the Romanian data protection authority (ANSPDCP): https://www.dataprotection.ro/.

sections.heading: Whether data is required
sections.body: Providing push subscription data is voluntary. If you do not provide it or withdraw consent, you will not receive promotional push notifications; other account features remain available.

sections.heading: Contact details
sections.body: You can reach us about orders, complaints or questions using the details below.

hero.subtitle: The perfect balance between <span1>nutritious food</span1>, <span2>specialty coffee</span2>, and <span3>community</span3>.

story.title: food with purpose, well-being and daily energy<1>.</1>
story.p1: <1>Alive</1> is a modern Bistro concept built around the idea of balance between good food, specialty coffee, functional drinks, energy, healthy lifestyle, and community.
story.p2: We do not want to build another rigid or elitist 'healthy' venue, but a warm, accessible, and authentic space where people can naturally integrate better habits into their daily lives.
story.p3: Alive will function as both a bistro and coffee spot, as well as a space for socializing, working, relaxing, and education around wellness and mindful nutrition.

pillars.subtitle: What You'll Discover at Alive
pillars.title: more than a bistro: a lifestyle<1>.</1>
pillars.p1_desc: A premium selection of specialty coffee, hot breakfast dishes, nourishing soups, and delicious main courses.
pillars.p2_desc: Fresh smoothies, protein shakes, and functional drinks with natural supplements dedicated to performance and well-being.
pillars.p3_desc: A warm and bright place where you can work on your laptop, read, or reconnect with friends in a calm atmosphere.

values.subtitle: Mission & Values
values.title: what do we believe in?<1>.</1>
values.description: The mission of <1>Alive</1> is to make a healthy lifestyle feel more natural, balanced, and sustainable. We believe in real food, nutritional supplements, quality ingredients, and experiences that make people feel good and in harmony with themselves.
values.v1_text: Real, tasty, and balanced food. A fine balance between exceptional taste, long-lasting energy, and real nutritional value, without dogmas or rigid restrictions.
values.v2_text: Through themed brunches, wellness educational events, and open discussions about nutrition, we support you in building better daily habits.
values.v3_text: More than a restaurant. We offer a welcoming space for socializing, productive work, relaxation, or a simple refreshing break from the daily hustle.
values.v4_text: We use premium, seasonal ingredients and clean recipes. We tell you exactly what your food and drink contains: from specialty coffee to active supplements.
